description: This file contains CSS styles for theme management and layout of the application, including variables for light and dark themes, classes for layout and design, and media queries for responsiveness.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container class that centers content and adapts background and text colors based on active theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Class for the application logo, providing height and animation.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Class for the header section, managing background color, layout, and text styling.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Class for styling application links with specific colors and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Class for the theme toggle button including position, background color, and hover effects.
